about_the_game:
Turn your guitar into a video game controller and master your favorite songs with real-time visual feedback.

SongVisualizer is a performance-driven guitar learning application that transforms practice into an engaging, gamified experience. Simply plug in your guitar using any standard USB interface or cable, load your Guitar Pro 5 files, and watch as your playing comes to life on the note highway.

Key Features:

  • Real-Time Pitch Detection - Works with any guitar interface, from basic 1/4" to USB cables to professional audio interfaces

  • Career Mode - Travel the world map, unlock new countries and cities, and conquer venues with progressively challenging setlists

  • Performance Analytics - Track your accuracy, timing, and progress with detailed statistics and visual heatmaps

  • Dynamic Tempo Adjustment - The game automatically adjusts tempo based on your performance, helping you master difficult sections

  • Measure Master - Practice specific sections on loop with customizable tempo and difficulty settings

  • Automatic Session Tracking - Every playthrough is automatically recorded and analyzed for continuous improvement

  • Multiple Tuning Support - E Standard, Drop D, Drop C, Open G, and more with custom frequency calibration

  • Deep Dive Analytics - View your performance trends over time with accuracy graphs, grade distributions, and measure-by-measure breakdowns

  • No Proprietary Hardware Required - Use your existing guitar and any compatible audio interface

Whether you're perfecting that challenging solo or working through your favorite album, SongVisualizer provides the visual feedback and gamification elements to keep you motivated and improving. The application reads standard Guitar Pro 5 files, giving you access to thousands of songs without any built-in music library restrictions.

Perfect for intermediate to advanced guitarists who want detailed performance tracking and a structured approach to improvement.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4330 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU with 1GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA/PulseAudio compatible, <20ms latency capable
  • Additional Notes: 60Hz display required (not 59Hz, 144Hz, etc.). Requires guitar/bass with 1/4" output jack and USB audio interface. Rocksmith Real Tone Cable or ASIO interface recommended.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / Latest SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 with Mesa drivers
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ASIO-compatible audio interface via JACK
  • Additional Notes: 60Hz display required (not 59Hz, 144Hz, etc.). Requires guitar/bass with 1/4" output jack and USB audio interface. Rocksmith Real Tone Cable or ASIO interface recommended.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4330 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU (Intel HD 4400 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible, <20ms latency capable
  • Additional Notes: 60Hz display required (not 59Hz, 144Hz, etc.). Requires guitar/bass with 1/4" output jack and USB audio interface. Rocksmith Real Tone Cable or ASIO interface recommended. Disable NVIDIA Shadowplay for best performance.
